y-m-47-01.title: Lokho umphumela wophenyo odwa ongakutsheli nongakutsheli
y-m-47-01.topic: Inani lamalungu enyunyana nokuthi ulwazi lwanele yini
y-m-47-01.goal: Hlulela ukuthi ulwazi mayelana nenani lamalungu amasethi lwanele yini, buyekeza isiphetho nobubanzi bamanani angenzeka lapho kufika ulwazi olusha, futhi wenze wena amacala anelisa zonke izimo.
y-m-47-01.material: Abafundi abangu-40 bonyaka wokuqala esikoleni baphenywa mayelana nokuthi benza yini imisebenzi 'ukubhukuda' no-'ukugijima'. Umfundi angenza yomibili imisebenzi, noma angenzi nanoma yiyiphi. Uthisha ophethe ukutshela imiphumela yophenyo isinyathelo ngesinyathelo. Hlulela ukuthi ulwazi olunikeziwe lukuvumela ukunquma yini 'inani labafundi abenza kokubili ukubhukuda nokugijima'. (U-n(A) usho inani lamalungu esethi u-A futhi ufundwa 'n of A'.)
y-m-47-01.thinking.2: Ukwenza wena amacala anelisa zonke izimo nokuhlola ububanzi obungenzeka
y-m-47-01.prereq.0: Umfundi uyazi incazelo yamasethi, inyunyana nokuhlangana, nophawu u-n(A) lwenani lamalungu (u-H1 walesi sinqumo ungezinga kuphela lobunzima nokusekela futhi akusho ukuthi unikezwe ibanga elithile. Cabanga ukuthi umfundi uyifunda inyunithi ethi 'Amasethi Nezindlela Zokucabanga' ye-Common Mathematics yesikole esiphakeme.)
y-m-47-01.prereq.1: Ukuhlangabezana nokuhlukanisa nokubala amalungu ngaphandle kokuhlangana usebenzisa imidwebo ye-Venn noma amathebula
y-m-47-01.s.s1.prompt: Uthisha ukutshela imiphumela yophenyo linye ngesikhathi. Isikhathi ngasinye lapho kufika ulwazi olusha, phinda uhlole isahlulelo sakho mayelana no-'inani labafundi abenza kokubili'.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.hint.0: Emgqeni owodwa, bhala ukuthi ucezu ngalunye lolwazi lukutshela ini mayelana namaqembu amane 'ukubhukuda kuphela, ukugijima kuphela, kokubili, akukho'.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.hint.1: Zama ukufaka izinombolo ukuze amaqembu amane engeze abe ngu-40, futhi uhlole ukuthi ahambisana nolwazi yini.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Abafundi abangu-25 benza ukubhukuda, abafundi abangu-22 benza ukugijima, futhi abafundi abangu-40 ngokuphelele baphendule ophenyweni.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Bangaki abafundi abenza kokubili ukubhukuda nokugijima?
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Akunqunyiwe. Uma kungekho muntu owenza kokubili akenzi, abafundi abangu-7 bayahlangana, futhi uma kukhona abafundi abangenzi lutho, abafundi abaningi bahlangana. Amanani angenzeka angancishiswa abe abafundi abangu-7 noma ngaphezulu nabafundi abangu-22 noma ngaphansi. 'Akunqunyiwe libe inani elilodwa' no-'siyazi ububanzi' akuphikisani.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Izinombolo ezimbili ezengeziwe zidlula isamu elingu-40, futhi kungenzeka ungakasebenzi ukuthi lowo mehluko usho ini.
y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Uma silifanisa no-40, linqunywa libe ngu-7

y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Isahlulelo sokuthi akunqunyiwe sivumelekile. Kodwa bheka ukuthi ububanzi bamanani angenzeka bungancishiswa yini ngemikhawulo yezingu-25, 22, nesamu elingu-40 kuphela.

y-m-47-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Phinda ufunde lokho ulwazi olusha lukutshela kona ngo-'abafundi abangenzi lutho'.

y-m-47-05.title: Ukuhlola umthetho ka-서윤
y-m-47-05.topic: Iqiniso noma iphutha lesiphakamiso, nezibonelo eziphikisayo
y-m-47-05.goal: Khombisa ngesibonelo esiphikisayo ukuthi isiphakamiso esithi 'siyabamba kuwo wonke amacala' siphutha, hlela imibandela eyenza kuhlale kuyiqiniso, bese uchaza ukungalingani phakathi kwesibonelo esisodwa esiphikisayo nezibonelo eziningi ezibambayo.
y-m-47-05.material: 서윤 wenze umthetho. 'Ezinombolweni ezigcwele ezimbili a, b, uma a²>b² khona-ke a>b.' (a² ifundwa 'a ngesikwele'.) Ufuna ukuhlola ukuthi lo mthetho uyabamba ngempela yini kuwo wonke amapheya ezinombolo ezigcwele.
y-m-47-05.thinking.2: Ukuchaza ukungalingani phakathi kwesibonelo esiphikisayo nezibonelo ezibambayo
y-m-47-05.prereq.0: Iziphakamiso, incazelo yesibonelo esiphikisayo, nokubala izikwele zezinombolo ezigcwele (I-H1 yalo mbuthano iyizinga lobunzima nokusekelwa kuphela futhi ayisho ukuthi inikezwe ibanga elithile. Cabanga ukuthi umfundi ufunda iyunithi 'Sets and Propositions' ye-Common Mathematics yesikole samabanga aphezulu.)
y-m-47-05.prereq.1: Kuyasiza uma usubonile ukuhlukaniswa kwezici a²−b²=(a−b)(a+b), kodwa akudingekile
y-m-47-05.s.s1.prompt: 서윤 wenze umthetho othi 'Ezinombolweni ezigcwele ezimbili a, b, uma a²>b² khona-ke a>b.' (a² ifundwa 'a ngesikwele'.) Thola ama-(a, b) ama-3 ahlukile lapho lo mthetho ungabambi khona.
y-m-47-05.s.s1.hint.0: Shintsha elilodwa lika-a no-b libe yinombolo enegethivu bese uqhathanisa izikwele.
y-m-47-05.s.s1.hint.1: Ngokungafani necala a=3, b=2, hlola isibonelo lapho ushintsha izimpawu ukuze a ingabi nkulu kuno-b.
y-m-47-05.s.s1.fail.c2: Isisekelo a²>b² kufanele sibambe. Bala izikwele zika-a no-b ngqo bese uziqhathanisa.
y-m-47-05.s.s1.fail.c3: Isiphetho a>b akumele sibambe (a akumele abe mkhulu kuno-b).
y-m-47-05.s.s1.explain: Isibonelo esine-a²>b² kodwa a≤b siyisibonelo esiphikisayo. Uma (a, b)=(−3, 2), khona-ke 9>4 kodwa −3<2. Isibonelo esisodwa esiphikisayo sikhombisa ukuthi umthetho uyaphutha.
y-m-47-05.s.s2.prompt: Ufuna ukwengeza umbandela owodwa ukuze umthetho ube yiqiniso njalo. Khetha yonke imibandela eyenza kube yiqiniso njalo uma yengezwa.
y-m-47-05.s.s2.hint.0: Kumbandela osekukhethweni ngakunye, hlola ukuthi isibonelo esiphikisayo (a, b) owasenza ngaphambilini sifeza umbandela yini.
y-m-47-05.s.s2.r.b: Ngemva kokwengeza a≠b, hlola ukuthi isibonelo esiphikisayo owasenza ngaphambilini sisasele yini.
y-m-47-05.s.s2.r.d: Lo mbandela ubuvele ukhona kusukela ekuqaleni. Khumbula ukuthi izibonelo eziphikisayo zavela noma ngalo mbandela.
y-m-47-05.s.s2.r.e: Hlola ukuthi isibonelo esiphikisayo njenge-(−3, 2) sisasele ngaphansi kwalo mbandela.
y-m-47-05.s.s2.explain: a²−b²=(a−b)(a+b), ngakho uma a+b>0 no-a²>b², khona-ke a−b>0, ngakho a>b. Uma a no-b kokubili kuyiphozithivu, a+b>0, ngakho leli cala nalo liyiqiniso. Kokuthi a≠b, umbandela wezinombolo ezigcwele, nombandela lapho kuxutshwe inombolo enegethivu, isibonelo esiphikisayo njenge-(−3, 2) siyasala.
y-m-47-05.s.s3.prompt: 서윤 wahlola nge-a=5, b=3 wathi umthetho ulungile, 'ngakho lo mthetho uyiqiniso.' Bhalela 서윤 ukuthi zingaki izibonelo eziphikisayo ezidingekayo nokuthi kungani izibonelo eziningi ezifanelayo zingawenzi uba yiqiniso.
y-m-47-05.s.s3.hint.0: Beka u-(5, 3) u-서윤 awuhlolile eceleni kwesibonelo esiphikisayo owasenza ngenhla bese ubhala ukuthi yini ehlukile.
y-m-47-05.s.s3.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi kufanele uhlole amacala amangaki ukukhombisa 'ukuthi kuyabamba kuzo zonke izinombolo ezigcwele'.
y-m-47-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe incazelo yami ifaka isibonelo sesibonelo esiphikisayo (ipheya lezinombolo)?
y-m-47-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ubhale ngokucacile ukuthi 'siyabamba kuwo wonke amacala' no-'kunesibonelo lapho siyabamba khona' kuhlukile?
y-m-47-05.s.s3.model.0: Isibonelo esisodwa esiphikisayo sanele. Siyiqiniso kuphela uma siyabamba kuwo wonke amacala, futhi uma ngisho nelicala elilodwa njenge-a=−3, b=2 liwa, siyiphutha. Noma zingaki izibonelo ezilungile, njenge-5 no-3, akuwubufakazi.
y-m-47-05.s.s3.model.1: Isibonelo esisodwa esiphikisayo sanele, futhi ukuthola izibonelo eziningi ezibambayo akuhloli wonke amacala, ngakho akunakuba yisisekelo sokusho ukuthi siyiqiniso.

y-m-47-04.title: Yini engenziwa isinqumo uma wazi inani lezingxenye kuphela
y-m-47-04.topic: Inani lezingxenye zamasethi eqiniso nokuba yiqiniso noma amanga kwesiphakamiso
y-m-47-04.goal: Nquma ukuthi inani lezingxenye zamasethi eqiniso kuphela linquma yini ukuba yiqiniso noma amanga kwe-'uma p khona q', hlunga ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi olwengeziwe olunquma, bese wenza izimo ezenza amanga wena.
y-m-47-04.material: I-universal set U yakhiwa yizinombolo zemvelo ezingu-12 kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-12. Vumela amasethi eqiniso ezimo ezimbili p, q abe ngu-P, Q, futhi n(P)=4, n(Q)=7. (n(P) inani lezingxenye ze-P. Pᶜ i-complement ka-P, ∪ inyunyana, futhi ∩ i-intersection.) Ngalolu lwazi kuphela, ufuna ukunquma ukuthi isiphakamiso 'uma p khona q' siyiqiniso noma singamanga.
y-m-47-04.thinking.1: Ukuhlunga ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi olwengeziwe olunquma isinqumo
y-m-47-04.prereq.0: Amasethi eqiniso, amasethi angaphansi, ubudlelwano 'uma isiphakamiso uma p khona q siyiqiniso, khona P⊂Q', nenani lezingxenye zesethi (I-H1 yalesi sethi iyizinga lobunzima nolwesekelo kuphela futhi ayisho ukuthi inikezwa ibanga elithile. Cabanga ukuthi umfundi ufunda isigaba 'Amasethi Nezimiso' se-Common Mathematics yesikole esiphakeme.)
y-m-47-04.prereq.1: Isipiliyoni sokubala ngemidwebo ye-Venn ukuthi n(P∪Q) no-n(P∩Q) bahlobene komunye nomunye
y-m-47-04.s.s1.prompt: Wazi kuphela u-n(P)=4 no-n(Q)=7, isiphakamiso 'uma p khona q' siyiqiniso noma singamanga? Khetha isinqumo esifaneleke kakhulu.
y-m-47-04.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola ukuthi ungenza yini icala elilodwa lapho P⊂Q nelilodwa lapho kungenjalo.
y-m-47-04.s.s1.hint.1: Ku-U={1, 2, ..., 12}, nquma izingxenye ezimbalwa ngayinye ye-P ne-Q bese uzibhala wena.
y-m-47-04.s.s1.r.a: Ucabange ukuthi lena enezingxenye ezimbalwa ingena kulena enezingxenye eziningi. Hlola ukuthi inombolo yodwa ingakutshela ukuthi izingxenye ze-P empeleni ziku-Q yini.
y-m-47-04.s.s1.o.b: Akunakunqunywa, ngoba asazi ukuthi P ingaphakathi ku-Q yini
y-m-47-04.s.s1.o.c: Iphutha, ngoba n(P) no-n(Q) kuhlukile komunye nomunye
y-m-47-04.s.s1.r.c: Hlola ukuthi izinombolo ezihlukile zikhomba esiphethweni sokuthi izingxenye ze-P azikho ku-Q.
y-m-47-04.s.s1.o.d: Ayikwazi ukunqunywa, ngoba asazi izingxenye zesethi yendawo yonke U
y-m-47-04.s.s1.r.d: U isivele inikeziwe njengezinombolo zemvelo kusukela ku-1 kuya ku-12. Cabanga futhi ukuthi yini engenakwaziwa.
y-m-47-04.s.s1.explain: Ulwazi alwanele. Ukuze 'uma p khona-ke q' kube yiqiniso, sidinga P⊂Q, kodwa ngo-n(P)=4 no-n(Q)=7 kuphela asikwazi ukusho ukuthi izingxenye ezi-4 ze-P zingaphakathi ku-Q yini. Kunamacala lapho P⊂Q nalapho kungenjalo.
y-m-47-04.s.s2.prompt: Khetha wonke amacala lapho, uma ufunda ucezu olulodwa olwengeziwe lolwazi, kunqunywa ukuthi 'uma p khona-ke q' liyiqiniso noma iphutha. (Akunandaba ukuthi kunqunywa njengeqiniso noma iphutha.)
y-m-47-04.s.s2.hint.0: Thola ukuthi ukhetho ngalunye lumisa u-n(P∩Q) ku-nani muni.
y-m-47-04.s.s2.hint.1: Dweba ukuthi P no-Q babukeka kanjani uma n(P∩Q) ingu-4 nalapho incane kuno-4.
y-m-47-04.s.s2.r.a: Leli yinani ongase usazi kusukela ku-n(P)=4 no-U onezingxenye ezingu-12. Hlola ukuthi kuyulwazi olusha yini.
y-m-47-04.s.s2.o.c: Okungenani eyodwa yezingxenye ze-P nayo ingeka-Q
y-m-47-04.s.s2.r.c: Hlola ukuthi, kusukela ekutheni eyodwa yazo ingeka-Q, ungasho yini ukuthi ezinye ezi-3 nazo ziyeka-Q.

Nikeza ama-universal set amabili, bese uchazela umngani wakho, usebenzisa izinombolo, ukuthi kungani kunjalo ngayinye.
y-m-47-03.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala zonke izinombolo ezanelisa x²=4, bese usebenza ukuthi lezo zinombolo ziku-universal set yini.

y-m-47-03.s.s3.model.0: Uma i-universal set iyizinombolo zangempela zonke, x=−2 nayo yanelisa x²=4, ngakho kuyisimo esanelisayo hhayi esidingekayo. Kodwa uma ubheka izinombolo zangempela eziphozithivu kuphela, izimo ezimbili ziba yinto efanayo. Ngakho kumele usho i-universal set kuqala ukwenza isinqumo.
y-m-47-03.s.s3.model.1: Uma ibanga lika-x lingamanani emvelo, x=2 no-x²=4 kuyisimo esifanayo. Kodwa uma ulikhulisa libe yizinombolo eziphelele zonke, u-−2 uyangena futhi kuyashintsha. Udinga ukwazi ibanga ukwenza isinqumo.

y-m-47-07.title: Ukukhetha nokwenza imibandela emibili yezikhathi eziningi wena
y-m-47-07.topic: Ukwenza ubudlelwano obudingekayo nobanele bemibandela eminingi
y-m-47-07.goal: Hlulela ubudlelwano bokufakwa kwemibandela emibili eyenziwe ngezikhathi eziningi, yenza amapheya amaningi emibandela lapho owodwa wanele kodwa engadingekile, bese uhlulela ubudlelwano uma isiqondiso siphambilisiwe.
y-m-47-07.material: Ufuna ukwenza imibandela emibili mayelana nenombolo yemvelo x: 'p: x iyinombolo eyizikhathi eziningi ze-a' no-'q: x iyinombolo eyizikhathi eziningi ze-b'. Kuye ngokuthi ukhetha kanjani a no-b, p ingaba umbandela owanele ku-q, umbandela odingekayo, noma kungabi kokubili. (Uma 'uma p khona-ke q' iyiqiniso, p umbandela owanele ku-q.)
y-m-47-07.thinking.0: Ukuhlulela imibandela ngobudlelwano bokufakwa kwamasethi eqiniso
y-m-47-07.thinking.1: Ukwenza amapheya ahlukile afeza umkhawulo wena
y-m-47-07.prereq.0: Incazelo yezikhathi eziningi nencazelo yemibandela edingekayo neyanele (I-H1 yalo mbuthano iyizinga lobunzima nokusekelwa kuphela futhi ayisho ukuthi inikezwe ibanga elithile. Cabanga ukuthi umfundi ufunda iyunithi 'Sets and Propositions' ye-Common Mathematics yesikole samabanga aphezulu.)
y-m-47-07.prereq.1: Ukuhlulela p⇒q ngobudlelwano bokufakwa kwamasethi eqiniso
y-m-47-07.s.s1.prompt: Kunombolo yemvelo x, p: x iyinombolo eyizikhathi eziningi ze-12, q: x iyinombolo eyizikhathi eziningi ze-8. p umbandela wohlobo luni ku-q?
y-m-47-07.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala izinombolo ezimbalwa eziyizikhathi eziningi ze-12 nezimbalwa eziyizikhathi eziningi ze-8.
y-m-47-07.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola ngokwehlukana ukuthi isiqondiso ngasinye kwezimbili, kusuka ku-p kuya ku-q nokusuka ku-q kuya ku-p, sihlala sibamba yini.
y-m-47-07.s.s1.r.a: Hlola ngqo nge-12, 24, 36 ukuthi zonke izinombolo eziyizikhathi eziningi ze-12 ziyizikhathi eziningi ze-8 yini.
y-m-47-07.s.s1.r.b: Funa inombolo eyizikhathi eziningi ze-8 engeyona eyizikhathi eziningi ze-12.
y-m-47-07.s.s1.r.c: Qala uhlole isiqondiso: ingabe 'uma p khona-ke q' noma okuphambene? Bheka nokuthi kukhona yini inombolo eyizikhathi eziningi ze-12 engeyona eyizikhathi eziningi ze-8.
y-m-47-07.s.s1.explain: Phakathi kwezinombolo eziyizikhathi eziningi ze-12, kunezinombolo njenge-12 ezingezona izikhathi eziningi ze-8, ngakho akusona umbandela owanele, futhi phakathi kwezinombolo eziyizikhathi eziningi ze-8, kunezinombolo njenge-8 ezingezona izikhathi eziningi ze-12, ngakho akusona umbandela odingekayo nakho.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.prompt: p: x iyinombolo eyizikhathi eziningi ze-a, q: x iyinombolo eyizikhathi eziningi ze-b (x iyinombolo yemvelo, a no-b kuyizinombolo ezigcwele kusukela ku-2 kuya ku-100). Yenza ama-(a, b) ama-3 ahlukile lapho p ingumbandela owanele ku-q kodwa ingeyona umbandela odingekayo.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.hint.0: Khetha izinombolo ezincane a no-b, bhala izinombolo ezimbalwa eziyizikhathi eziningi ze-a nezika-b, bese uhlola ubudlelwano bokufakwa.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi kufanele kube nobudlelwano buni phakathi kuka-a no-b ukuze zonke izinombolo eziyizikhathi eziningi ze-a ziyizikhathi eziningi ze-b.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.ok.c1: a no-b kuyizinombolo ezigcwele kusukela ku-2 kuya ku-100.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.fail.c1: a no-b kufanele zibe yizinombolo ezigcwele kusukela ku-2 kuya ku-100.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Yonke inombolo eyizikhathi eziningi ze-a iyizikhathi eziningi ze-b (umbandela owanele).
y-m-47-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Ukuze yonke inombolo eyizikhathi eziningi ze-a ibe yizikhathi eziningi ze-b, a kufanele ibe yizikhathi eziningi ze-b. Hlola ukuthi kukhona yini inombolo eyizikhathi eziningi ze-a engeyona eyizikhathi eziningi ze-b.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.ok.c3: Kunenombolo efeza q kodwa ingafezi p (akusona umbandela odingekayo).
y-m-47-07.s.s2.fail.c3: Uma a=b imibandela emibili iyafana, ngakho iba umbandela odingekayo futhi owanele.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.explain: Amapheya anjenge-(12, 4), (6, 3), (10, 5), (9, 3) ayenzeka. Uma a iyizikhathi eziningi ze-b futhi zihlukile, yonke inombolo eyizikhathi eziningi ze-a iyizikhathi eziningi ze-b, kodwa b uqobo akayona izikhathi eziningi ze-a.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.because.prompt: Khetha elilodwa lama-(a, b) akho, bese ubhala ukuthi kungani 'uma p khona-ke q' ihlala ibamba nesibonelo senombolo efeza q kodwa ingafezi p.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.because.hint.0: Kuma-(a, b) owakhethile, qala ubhale ukuthi a ingabhalwa kanjani njengo-b izikhathi inombolo ethile.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.because.hint.1: Hlukanisa ngqo ukuhlola ukuthi b ngokwayo wanelisa p yini.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uhlolile ngokuhlukanisa ukuthi inombolo engiyinikeze ngempela iyisiphindaphindi senombolo ka-q futhi hhayi isiphindaphindi senombolo ka-p?
y-m-47-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe incazelo yakho ifaka ukuthi 'isiphindaphindi sika-a sinesimo b izikhathi inombolo ethile'?
y-m-47-07.s.s2.because.model.0: Ngikhethe a=12, b=4. Isiphindaphindi sika-12 sihlala siyisiphindaphindi sika-4 ngoba 12=4×3. Kodwa u-4 uyisiphindaphindi sika-4 futhi akayona isiphindaphindi sika-12, ngakho akuwona umbandela odingekayo.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.because.model.1: Ngu-(6, 3). Wonke amaphindaphinda ka-6 angamaphindaphinda ka-3 ngoba 6=3×2. Ngokuphambene, u-3 uyisiphindaphindi sika-3 kodwa hhayi sika-6, ngakho kuyisibonelo esiphikisayo.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.because.model.2: Ngu-(12, 3). Njengoba 12=3×4, isiphindaphindi sika-12 sihlala siyisiphindaphindi sika-3. Kodwa u-3 uyisiphindaphindi sika-3 futhi akayona isiphindaphindi sika-12.
y-m-47-07.s.s2.because.model.3: Singabhala a=b×k, ngakho isiphindaphindi sika-a siba yisiphindaphindi sika-b. b ngokwayo inelisa q kodwa ayinelisi p.
y-m-47-07.s.s3.prompt: Uma ushintshanisa a no-b wepheya owalenza esinyathelweni esingenhla bese uvumela p: x isiphindaphindi sika-b, q: x isiphindaphindi sika-a, p ingaba umbandela onjani ku-q? (Cabanga ukuthi a uyisiphindaphindi sika-b futhi bahlukile.)
y-m-47-07.s.s3.hint.0: Faka izinombolo ezithile njengo-(a, b)=(12, 4) bese ubhala izibalo ezi-phindwayo zika-p no-q abashintshanisiwe.
y-m-47-07.s.s3.hint.1: Hlola isiqondiso: izibalo zesiphi zonke zifakiwe ezibalweni zesinye.
y-m-47-07.s.s3.r.a: Uma p iyizibalo zika-b futhi q iyizibalo zika-a, hlola ukuthi b, isibonelo sika-p, sinelisa q yini.
y-m-47-07.s.s3.r.c: Hlola ukuthi, uma a no-b behlukile, izibalo zemibandela emibili zingafana yini.
y-m-47-07.s.s3.r.d: Hlola ngezinombolo ezithile ukuthi iqiniso lokuthi a uyisiphindaphindi sika-b yenza ubudlelwano bokufakwa obunjani phakathi kwemibandela emibili.
y-m-47-07.s.s3.explain: Uma a uyisiphindaphindi sika-b futhi bahlukile, isiphindaphindi ngasinye sika-a siyisiphindaphindi sika-b. Ngemva kokushintshanisa, isiphindaphindi ngasinye sika-q siyisiphindaphindi sika-p, ngakho 'uma q khona-ke p', okungukuthi, p uyimbandela odingekayo. Kodwa b unelisa p futhi akanelisi q, ngakho akuwona umbandela owanele.

y-m-47-06.title: Ukuhlola ubufakazi be-'uma a+b>10 khona-ke ...'
y-m-47-06.goal: Qhathanisa ukuvumelana kwezindlela zobufakazi, thola iphutha elenziwa uma kunqatshwa isiphetho bese ulungisa i-contrapositive, bese wenza wena isibonelo esiphikisayo se-contrapositive engalungile.
y-m-47-06.material: Bheka izindlela zokufakazela isiphakamiso 'ezinombolweni zangempela a, b, uma a+b>10 khona-ke a>5 noma b>5', nobufakazi bomfundi oyedwa. (a>5 ifundwa 'a inkulu kuno-5'.)
y-m-47-06.prereq.0: I-contrapositive yesiphakamiso, ukunqatshwa kwe-'noma' ne-'futhi', nezici zokungalingani (I-H1 yalo mbuthano iyizinga lobunzima nokusekelwa kuphela futhi ayisho ukuthi inikezwe ibanga elithile. Cabanga ukuthi umfundi ufunda iyunithi 'Sets and Propositions' ye-Common Mathematics yesikole samabanga aphezulu.)
y-m-47-06.prereq.1: Umfundi uyazi ukuthi i-contrapositive inenani leqiniso elifanayo nesiphakamiso sokuqala
y-m-47-06.s.s1.prompt: Ufuna ukufakazela isiphakamiso 'ezinombolweni zangempela a, b, uma a+b>10 khona-ke a>5 noma b>5'. Khetha zonke izindlela zobufakazi ezivumelekile.
y-m-47-06.s.s1.hint.0: Kukhetho ngalunye, bala ukuthi lukhombisa ukuthi isitatimende siyabamba 'kuwo wonke amapheya ezinombolo zangempela' yini.
y-m-47-06.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala njengokungalingani ukuthi kusho ini ukuthi 'a>5 noma b>5' iyiphutha.
y-m-47-06.s.s1.o.a: Khombisa ukuthi a+b>10 iyaphuka ngaphansi kombandela onqabela isiphetho
y-m-47-06.s.s1.o.b: Khetha amapheya ambalwa ezinombolo ane-a+b>10 bese uhlola ukuthi isiphetho silungile
y-m-47-06.s.s1.r.b: Bala ukuthi ukuhlola izibonelo ezimbalwa kukhombisa ukuthi kuyabamba kuwo wonke amapheya ezinombolo zangempela yini.
y-m-47-06.s.s1.o.c: Thola amanani ka-a no-b ngqo bese uwaqhathanisa no-5
y-m-47-06.s.s1.r.c: Hlola ukuthi a+b>10 yodwa inquma amanani ka-a no-b abe nani elilodwa yini.
y-m-47-06.s.s1.o.d: Cabanga ukuthi isiphetho siyiphutha bese ubona ukuthi kuvela yini impikiswano
y-m-47-06.s.s1.explain: Ukukhombisa ukuthi a+b≤10 ngaphansi kombandela onqabela isiphetho (a≤5 futhi b≤5) kuwukufakazela i-contrapositive, futhi ukucabanga ukuthi isiphetho siyiphutha bese ukhombisa impikiswano no-a+b>10 nakho kuyindlela evumelekile. Ukuhlola amapheya ambalwa ezinombolo akuwubufakazi, futhi isisekelo sodwa asinqumi amanani ka-a no-b.
y-m-47-06.s.s2.prompt: Elilodwa lazo lifakazelwe kusetshenziswa i-contrapositive. Khetha umugqa wokuqala ophutha.
y-m-47-06.s.s2.hint.0: Yenza wena i-contrapositive. Qala ubhale ukuthi uthola kungalingani muni ngokunqabela isiphetho 'a>5 noma b>5'.
y-m-47-06.s.s2.hint.1: Yehla umugqa ngomugqa kusukela phezulu, faka isitatimende salowo mugqa emapheyeni ezinombolo, bese uhlola ukuthi silandela kahle kumugqa owandulele yini.
y-m-47-06.s.s2.line.0: Isiphakamiso okufanele sifakazelwe: uma a+b>10 khona-ke a>5 noma b>5.

y-m-47-06.s.s2.line.3: I-contrapositive iyiqiniso, ngakho nesiphakamiso sokuqala siyiqiniso.

y-m-47-06.s.s3.hint.1: Kupheya ngalinye olikhethile, hlola 'a≤5 noma b≤5' no-'a+b>10' ngokwehlukana.
y-m-47-06.s.s3.fail.c1: a no-b kufanele zibe yizinombolo ezigcwele kusukela ku-−1000 kuya ku-1000.
y-m-47-06.s.s3.fail.c2: Uma a no-b kokubili kukhulu kuno-5, 'a≤5 noma b≤5' ayibambi.
y-m-47-06.s.s3.fail.c3: Uma a+b ingu-10 noma ngaphansi, isiphetho salesi siphakamiso siyaphela sibambile.
y-m-47-06.s.s3.explain: Amapheya anjenge-(5, 6), (0, 11), (4, 20) yizibonelo eziphikisayo. Noma elilodwa lingu-5 noma ngaphansi, uma elinye likhulu ngokwanele isamba sidlula u-10. I-contrapositive elungile ithi 'uma a≤5 futhi b≤5 khona-ke a+b≤10'.

y-m-47-09.title: Umusho onokuthi 'ukhona' unqunywa nini?
y-m-47-09.goal: Qonda ukuthi umusho wesimo 'ukhona ...' unqunywa njengeqiniso isibonelo esisodwa esigcinayo futhi awunqunywa njengamanga noma zingaki izibonelo ezehlulekile, bhala ukuphika kahle, bese uthola wena amanani anelisa umbandela.
y-m-47-09.material: Umusho S: 'Kwenye inombolo yangempela x, x²<x.' (x² ngu-x squared.) Ufuna ukufaka amanani eyodwa ngesikhathi ubone ukuthi kunqunywa nini ukuthi S iyiqiniso noma amanga. Cabanga ukuthi ungahlola inani elilodwa kuphela ngesikhathi.
y-m-47-09.thinking.0: Ukuhlola nokubuyekeza isahlulelo sakho ngokwemiphumela yokuhlola
y-m-47-09.prereq.0: Incazelo yezitatimende ezinokuthi 'wonke' no-'ukhona' nokuphika kwazo, nokuhlola ukungalingani x²<x ngokufaka izinombolo (i-H1 yale nxenye iyizinga lobunzima nokusekelwa kuphela futhi ayisho ukuthi yabelwe ibanga elithile. Cabanga ukuthi umfundi uyafunda isigaba 'Amasethi Nezindlela Zokucabanga' se-Common Mathematics yesikole esiphakeme.)
y-m-47-09.s.s1.prompt: Kumusho othi 'ukhona ...', kumele kuhlolwe amanani amangaki ukuze ukuthi iyiqiniso noma amanga kunqunywe? Njengoba iziphumo zokuhlola ziqongelela, hlola isahlulelo sakho.
y-m-47-09.s.s1.hint.0: Phinda incazelo yomusho S njengo-'kukhona okungenani inombolo eyodwa yangempela enjalo'.
y-m-47-09.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala amanani ahloliwe ethebuleni bese uqhathanisa osayizi be-x no-x² kwelinye ngalinye.
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.0.info: Umusho S: 'Kwenye inombolo yangempela x, x²<x.' (x² ngu-x squared.) Njengokuhlola kokuqala ngifake u-x=2, futhi 2²=4, no-4<2 amanga.
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.0.after: U-x=2 ongenelisi umbandela kusho kuphela ukuthi 'u-x=2 akwenzi u-S abe yiqiniso'. Kungenzeka ube nomuzwa wokuthi kubonakala kuyamanga. 'Ukhona' uyiqiniso uma likhona ngisho nelilodwa inani elinelisa, ngakho uma amanani angahloliwe asele, awukwazi ukunquma.
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Sebenza ukuthi kuyitshela ini ngomusho wonke uma kuvela inani elilodwa elingagcini emshweni onokuthi 'ukhona'.
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Hlola ukuthi livele yini ngisho nelilodwa inani elinelisayo.
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.1.info: Ngifake futhi no-x=−1, 0, 3, 10, futhi kuzo zonke x²<x amanga (x²≥x).
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.1.ask: Inani lamanani ahloliwe likhule laba ngu-5. Isahlulelo sakho ngo-S siyini manje?
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.1.after: Ngisho noma wonke amanani ahloliwe ehlulekile, uma amanani angahloliwe asele, S ayinqunyiwe. Kungenzeka ube nomuzwa wokuthi kubonakala kungamanga, kodwa lokho akusona isiqinisekiso. Ukuze unqume, kumele ukhombise ukuthi kungani umbandela uphuka kuzo zonke izinombolo zangempela.
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Sebenza ukuthi kuqinisekisiwe yini ukuthi phakathi kwamanani angeyona ayi-5 ahloliwe, akukho elinelisa umbandela.
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Hlola ukuthi livele yini inani elinelisayo.
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kusukela kulo mphumela wokuhlola, isahlulelo sakho ngo-S siyini?
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.2.after: 'Kwenye x, ...' iyiqiniso uma likhona ngisho no-x oyedwa oyagcina. Iyagcina ku-x=0.5, ngakho noma zingaki izikhathi amanani ehlulekile ngaphambilini, S iyiqiniso.
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.2.o.a: S ayiyona iqiniso. Ayizange igcine ku-x omningi
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Hlola ukuthi kwenzekani uma likhona ngisho nelilodwa inani eligcinayo, hhayi 'abaningi'.
y-m-47-09.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Inani eligcinayo selivele ngempela. Funda futhi ukuthi leli nani linomthelela muni encazelweni yomusho S.
y-m-47-09.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni besingakwazi ukuhlulela, futhi noma izibonelo ezehlulekile ziqongelela akuzange kunqunywe, kodwa lapho kuvela isibonelo esisodwa esigcinayo kwanqunywa. Qhathanisa ukuthi umsebenzi owenziwa yisibonelo esisodwa uhluka kanjani emshweni onokuthi 'ukhona' nomusho onokuthi 'wonke'.
y-m-47-09.s.s2.prompt: Yikuphi ukuphika okufanelekile komusho S: 'Kwenye inombolo yangempela x, x²<x'?
y-m-47-09.s.s2.hint.0: Hlola nge-x=0.5 ne-x=2 ukuthi S nomusho okukhetheni zingaba kokubili ziyiqiniso ngesikhathi esisodwa yini.
y-m-47-09.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola nge-x=0 ukuthi uphawu lokungalingani kumele lushintshe kanjani uma ushintsha 'ukhona' ube 'wonke'.
y-m-47-09.s.s2.o.a: Kunoma iyiphi inombolo yangempela x, x²>x
y-m-47-09.s.s2.r.a: Hlola ukuthi ukuphika kwe-'<' kungu-'>' yini. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwe-x² no-x bungabuphi uma x=0?
y-m-47-09.s.s2.r.b: Kushiye 'ukhona' njengoba unjalo futhi kushintshe kuphela uphawu lokungalingani. Hlola ukuthi u-x=2 wenza lo musho ube yiqiniso yini, nokuthi lokhu kungaba ukuphika kuka-S yini.
y-m-47-09.s.s2.r.c: Hlola ukuthi S nalo musho kungaba kokubili kuyiqiniso yini.
y-m-47-09.s.s2.o.d: Kunoma iyiphi inombolo yangempela x, x²≥x
y-m-47-09.s.s2.explain: Ukuphika kwe-'ukhona ...' kungu-'kunoma yini ..., akunjalo'. Ukuphika kwe-x²<x kungu-x²≥x (kufaka no-x²=x), ngakho 'kunoma iyiphi inombolo yangempela x, x²≥x' kuyikuphika. Ngendlela, S iyiqiniso, ngakho lokhu kuphika kungamanga. U-x=0.5 uyisibonelo esiphikisayo.
y-m-47-09.s.s3.prompt: Ukukhombisa ukuthi S iyiqiniso, udinga u-x oyedwa onelisa umbandela. Thola izinombolo zangempela ezi-3 ezihlukene x ezanelisa x²<x.
y-m-47-09.s.s3.hint.0: Faka inombolo ephakathi kuka-0 no-1 njengo-x=0.5 bese ubala x² no-x ngayinye.
y-m-47-09.s.s3.hint.1: Shintsha u-x phakathi kuka-0 no-1 bese uthola ububanzi lapho x² iba yincane kuno-x.
y-m-47-09.s.s3.fail.c1: x²<x ayigcini. Faka u-0.1, 0.5, 2, njalo njalo esikhundleni sika-x bese uqhathanisa x² no-x.
y-m-47-09.s.s3.explain: Zonke izinombolo zangempela phakathi kuka-0 no-1 ziyenzeka. Uma x ingu-0 noma ingu-1, x²=x, futhi uma x ikhulu kuno-1 noma ingemuhle, x²>x.
